spec.authoredModuleSummary: Core defines the rendering engine that parses talk content and walks/encodes components into the HTML and props used to render a piece, including the error-raising checks that validate talk structure.
spec.description:
`core.mjs` — Core. Called from `index.renderTalk` and `runtime.boot`, and possibly from places the call graph cannot see. At run time it reaches `parse`. `stopShape` builds `visit`, `checkPhotoSentence` builds `els`, `checkPhotoSentence` builds `attr`, `resolveComponent` builds `attrNames`, `renderBody` builds `info`, `renderBody` builds `isIsland`, `renderBody` builds `onClient`, `renderBody` builds `readsSteps`, `renderBody` builds `nextId`, `renderBody` builds `fill`, `renderBody` builds `svgClass`, `renderBody` builds `htmlProps`, `renderBody` builds `toElement`, `renderBody` builds `toNodes`, `renderBody` builds `toProps`, `renderBody` builds `slot`, `renderBody` builds `encodeNodes`, `renderBody` builds `encode`, `renderBody` builds `encodeElement`, `renderBody` builds `contextOf`, `renderBody` builds `renderIsland` and `walk` builds `values`, and no requirement here is about what runs inside them. `asLibraryImage` has 2 failure conditions and 1 of them is stated here and `fromJson` has 16 failure conditions and 6 of them are stated here — the rest are in the findings in Predictable Code (the Control Center, or your editor). Checks: “`extractTalk` throws `TagError` when the `length` of `blocks` is present and is not falsy and the `length` of `blocks` is greater than 1.” and 3 more. 7 requirements: 3 violated, 4 verified. 49 stated failures.

3 findings reachable from current code (2 distinct problems — each counted where it happens and again at the caller that reaches it) produced no requirement — on `describe` (1): the analysis reports a reachable failure; on `walk` (1): the analysis reports a reachable failure.
